findings.description: Generic Update/Release chips split into vertical letters and overlap resident ownership/value labels during representative motion.
Desktop settled and moving text registers split running and restored across lines because the committed value uses a narrow reserved column.

FSDP redundant ledger removed; MoE identity-bearing payloads and expert owners are legible; fusion owners I1/I2 fit; FlashAttention decimal operands, accumulator state, and normalized outputs fit both widths.

inspection_method.settled: All state/case/profile PNGs inspected through native text resolution scene contact sheets; full component PNGs inspected as needed for controls, caption, source values, and numerical fit.
inspection_method.motion: One nontrivial action per lesson in every profile; Next then K pauses around nominal 360 ms of a 900 ms action. Reported WAAPI times are actual sampled times. Prior committed index and target index asserted for every capture.

shared_controls.scope: Shared controls are covered by the separate runtime regression report. This author report adds actual emitted chapter states and representative paused motion; it does not repeat the full shared control matrix.

limitations: No real students, controlled learner study, or measured learning gain.
All authored endpoints inspected; motion coverage is representative sampling rather than every transition at every instant.
Paused motion capture uses an enlarged viewport height so the complete mechanism can be inspected; phone width remains 390 pixels.
QA hides only the back-to-top button for image clearance.
Known runtime fixes are pending a new clean build; acceptance does not transfer automatically to another runtime or source digest.
